$$B = \frac{-569.33 + \sqrt{569.33^2 - 4(1)(-467,520)}}{2}$$
$$B = \frac{-569.33 + \sqrt{324,136 + 1,870,080}}{2}$$
$$B = \frac{-569.33 + 1,481.3}{2} = 455.98 \approx 456 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$
